socialPromo.headline: Farhan Deals: My Startup Story
socialPromo.subhead: From zero to online business hero, facing Pakistan's unique challenges.
socialPromo.scene: A young man (Farhan, without showing his face clearly) in a modest home office setting in Ahmadpur East, Pakistan, illuminated by the glow of a laptop screen at night. His desk is simple, perhaps with a cup of chai. He's intently looking at the screen, which shows a Shopify dashboard or an e-commerce website. A stack of old bank statements or a checkbook is subtly visible in the background, hinting at the challenges overcome. The mood is determined and hopeful, reflecting the late-night efforts and perseverance described in the story. The lighting is warm and focused on the screen, creating a sense of deep concentration.
socialPromo.caption: Farhan Deals ki shuruaat aasaan na thi. Bank account ki mushkilaat se lekar uncle ke account tak, meri kahani seekhne aur himmat ki misaal hai. Padhye aur janiye kaise maine online business shuru kiya!
